description: Wisconsin Works, or W-2, combines employment services with possible cash assistance while preparing for work. Apply through ACCESS or the local W-2 agency serving your area.
introduction: Wisconsin Works, or W-2, combines employment services with possible cash assistance while preparing for work. Apply through ACCESS or the local W-2 agency serving your area.

who: Parents with a child younger than 18 living with them who meet income and asset limits.
The local agency determines eligibility and the suitable employment service or placement.
sections.get: Employment planning, job matching, training, education connections and possibly cash assistance. Ask which placement and payment rules apply rather than assuming every participant receives the same grant.
sections.docs: Prepare household, income and asset information and child details. Describe work history and barriers such as child care, transportation, disability or safety issues for the assessment.
sections.apply:
1. Select Wisconsin Works through ACCESS, or contact the local W-2 agency.
  2. Complete the application and eligibility assessment.
  3. Discuss the employment plan and activities, including support needed to participate.
  4. Ask about referrals to FoodShare or other programs separately.
sections.after: Keep the employment plan and notices. Report problems meeting an activity before a missed appointment if possible. If you disagree with an eligibility decision, the program lists a Fact Finding Review. DCF customer service is 855-757-4539.
sections.sources:
• W-2 parent program and review rights
  • W-2 agency application rules
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Is W-2 only a cash benefit?
No; it provides employment services and some participants may receive cash assistance.
Does an ACCESS screening decide eligibility?
The local W-2 agency makes the decision after application.
Can I apply without online access?
Contact the local agency to complete the process.
Can a domestic abuse survivor contact another agency?
The current manual permits applying at any W-2 agency in that circumstance.
Ask for the program’s Fact Finding Review instructions.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
